products.name: Consignor Payout Exception Desk
products.product: A focused consignment store payout reconciliation workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent apparel, furniture, and specialty consignment stores
products.problem: Sale returns, discounts, fees, account details, holds, payout method, and unclaimed balances create recurring consignor questions.
products.valueProposition: Turns consignment store payout reconciliation into a visible operating queue so every payout exception is reconciled to item events and ends in an approved payment or documented hold.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets consignment store payout reconciliation software, consignment store payout reconciliation tracker, consignment store payout reconciliation template, and consignment store payout reconciliation checklist searches.
